topic: An employee is transferred to a different department
text: It seems like just yesterday we were all figuring out the ins and outs of our roles together, sharing tips, and making that tricky project timeline work. And now, here we are. I know things change, and opportunities come up, but it doesn’t make this moment any easier. I’m going to miss the way you always had a knack for finding the solution when we hit a roadblock, or how you’d bring in those little treats on Friday afternoons. The team won’t be the same without you. I hope this new chapter brings you everything you’re looking for and more. Let’s catch up soon, okay?
